criteria: A generation passes only when every expected semantic condition is visibly satisfied. Partial means the main concept is present but at least one condition is missing.

cases.notes: All three seeds produced one clearly male student in a school blazer.
All three removed scenery, but the backgrounds were pale pink, blue, or gray instead of pure white.
All three contained one boy and one girl, both visible.
All three contained exactly two girls with coordinated outfits.
All three retained head-to-toe framing and visible feet.
The envelope was visible in every seed, but one frame cropped the head and the other two read more as holding than offering.
All three showed a visible basketball and an active dribbling pose.
All three became close-ups without enough crop-safe margin.

nextActions: Use the model-card negative prompt and Euler Ancestral as defaults.
Add explicit exclusions for colored backgrounds and close-up framing.
Strengthen full-body, envelope-offering, and circular-crop prompt tags.
Re-run the three affected cases with the same seeds for an A/B comparison.
